title: Tragic death of Adichie's young son pushes Nigeria to act on health sector failings
summary: Novelist Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie says her child's death was caused by medical negligence, which the hospital denies.

title: Taiwan Reaches Trade Deal With Trump and Pledges More U.S. Chip Factories
summary: The Trump administration agreed to lower tariffs on Taiwanese goods, while Taiwan said it would invest more in U.S. manufacturing.

title: Incumbent President Museveni takes strong lead in Uganda election count
summary: Museveni is credited with 76 percent in early results; violence reported with opponent Bobi Wine under house arrest.

title: European Gas Jumps 20% on Week as ‘Perfect Storm’ Hits Sentiment
summary: European gas prices are set for their biggest weekly rally in over two years, with a change in sentiment taking hold as traders rush to cover short positions amid bouts of unusually cold weather.
